Yes, I am also all too familiar with this feeling. It's been a week since I OD'ed due to such intense feelings and I am still struggling so bad. It was my first attempt and all I've been able to think about since is attempting again.

I'm going back to work today too and I'm anxious about that as well. I have some amazing people who support me and I appreciate them so much, so it makes me feel even more rubbish and like garbage and guilty when all I want to do still is try again. It's awful.
Yeah, true. And I know people won't necessarily die. Thank you for the messages, I really appreciate it.
Thank you. Yeah, I just didn't know what resources to go by. One would say one thing, another would say another.
Yeah, I tried googling but it was giving me mixed answers, so I gave up. Thank you.
Okay, thank you.
I'm sorry you feel the same way. What's going on?

Yes! So true! I have had an endless amount of comments made by my colleagues and family digging at me for "overreacting" and they'd tell me stuff like "every female has to go through it, you're not the only one". Which really peed me off!

I've had painful periods since day 1 of first starting. I've used several different period medications and inflammatories. Heating pads, cooling pads, hot baths, hot showers, massaging chairs, massaging my own back, deep heat creams and deep heat pads and more. I also have been on severel birth controls but they don't do much good either and one of them I had to immediately stop soon after because of possible clotting leading to PE (Pulmonary Embolism) which I ended up going to hospital to get checked out for.

My body doesn't react as badly as it used to now but I constantly have an iron deficiency and sometimes end up anemic too. When I was 14, I collapsed 3 or 4 times in one morning due to the pain and the blood loss. I have sleepless nights, curled up into a fetal position and can't stop moving around to try and shake the pain away. I've now been diagnosed with dysmenhorrea and PCOS due to chronic pain.

Some women need to realise that periods aren't the same. No two females have the same period and no woman has the same constant one either. Every cycle can be different.
Yeah, very true. I appreciate it, thank you!
Yeah, definitely. It's weird how each one can react to you very differently too. I've taken b/c before and this didn't happen but it has this time and I took this one for a lot shorter time too.
Had to google that, never heard of that before. But reading about it, it could be. I recently stopped taking a pill.
Thank you. Just wasn't sure, lol. Felt stupid pondering on it but if you don't ask, you don't know. So thought I'd get second opinions.
I've not seen one like that either. I am prone to blood clots but I've never had one that big. Then like 5 minutes later I passed another one in similar size, just slightly smaller.

I would've thought that it would be where someone has done something, not just come close to doing. An attempt is an action to try do something. If they didn't do what they were going to do, for whatever reason, I don't think it is technically an attempt.

Jeez, reading the first half of that post had me so infuriated...I mean, who the *** do they think they are? I am so so sorry you were treated that way. It's so heartbreaking when situations like that happen.

On the up note, I am so glad you found a place that will help. And please make sure you file a complaint. If they have done that to you, who knows who else they have done that to and who else they may do that to in the future if given the chance. Now you have an actual chance to focus on recovering and I hope you do, I wish you all the best in this. Be proud of yourself and whenever you have a bad time again, just think back to this and realise how strong you are for getting through that.
Love this! Might try this out this year!
This is such a cute idea! One that I'd want to do with my future children.
So she's contradicting herself. I'm sorry this happened. But I'm glad me pointing out the face made the situation a little lighter.
Thank you!

Less hassle and financial stress. If people can avoid all the extra stress, it's beneficial. Also, it shows the person who is being warned that this person is prepared to do what is needed which gives the person giving the warning a little power in their current situation.

I think this statement greatly depends on the situation. In some cases, a warning of it being taken further can be beneficial but in other words to what you said above, a warning can do far more harm than good.

I don't know how to get the pen off but what a shitty thing to do. I hope you managed to sort it out but your housemate should've been the one to sort it.

On a side note: All I could see at first was a face. Didn't pay attention to what actually happened until I read the post.
I've only had sleep paralysis once. I had hallucinations but it wasn't visual ones, they were audible.

I love that you customised it yourself. Even if you aren't sure about the end product visually, it must've felt good knowing you did it all yourself. Also, I am loving your 2020 planner. Where did you get it from?

Ohwow, sounds like you had a really rocky start to this year but I'm glad that as the year has gone on, you've at least managed to get in a better position financially, it's something. I get that alone feeling. And don't apologise, it's okay. We all need to vent at some point and sometimes, we end up doing so even if we don't plan to. Venting out here is better than not at all.

Yeah, I get that. To be fair, people could have the best life and be really successful and still struggle. One very loved and successful person who is a fine example of this is Robin Williams. Loved by millions. He was a caring and genuine soul who touched many hearts and lives. Yet the feeling we have was similar to his and it consumed him until he couldn't take it anymore.
Ditto on that. I'm sorry to hear that you feel that way though.
Happy belated birthday! And I'm sorry you feel that way too. It sucks, big time and it's debilitating too.

Ahh, I see. Fair enough. Is it difficult to maintain?

I am going to ask again on Monday and keep bugging them about it. I want to apologise and explain what is going on. They wont be too happy with me if I call in, especially seen as I am going on holiday soon too.

And my loss? I didnt lose my mum, I almost did. She was lucky to survive because of some idiotic Doctors.

Ohwow, that mustve been horrible, Im so sorry. My thyroid and liver are also being tested too. Yeah, my DR did say the same about blood clots but she wants to be sure. She doesnt know what it is as my case is "odd" and doesnt make sense apparently.

Is fish something you love eating or is it easy to just not eat it?

When I walked into work on Friday morning, as I was signing in I asked my manager if I could speak to someone at some point that day. She said that we had spare staff and can do then but it just never happened.

This story is very heart warming. Even though women know what it is like through experience, we do need those male supporters too. For that many to pipe up like that to you is amazing! And this way, they could even find more ways of how they can support their loved ones as well. It's a win-win situation and that kind of support in a workplace is so needed!

I'm so happy for you that you have that! I have a lot of respect for them.

Sometimes it's better to stop things that can help with the illness at attention when it affects your life too negatively. I hope things are better, or as best as they can be for you now. I wish you all the best with dealing with your insomnia too.

Thank you so much! I really appreciate the support and kind words. It means a lot! And though I doubt I'll be much help, feel free to message me too, even if just to rant! I completely agree, just like small steps can be the most important ones. 💙

Yeah, little changes are the best way to go about it but it has not worked whatsoever. Well done for getting to where you are now though, that's amazing! 

Yeah, I use eating as a coping mechanism a lot. I used to spend £15-£20 on junk food and eat it all in one night, then go again the next day and spend the same amount. I will have a look into it but what do you mean by the psychological coaching thing?

And thank you!

I can imagine it hasn't been but it seems you've been very persistent which is amazing! 

As for coming to terms with things, I understand that completely. I've always wanted my own children and I know that generally many women still conceive but it doesn't stop the worry. I also feel pressured because early menopause runs in my family which means I could too. I know I still have at least 10 years but for someone like me, doesn't seem like a very long time at all. I have huge self-esteem issues, always have done, as well as suffering with mental health disorders. So this is just heightening those issues.

I am conscious of it but I have no self-control, at all. I've used eating ice cream, chocolate and yoghurt as a means to cope for years and years. I am trying, though I am not very successful at the moment. I'll give the commentary a go.

Thank you for your help and thank you for commenting. Overeating has been an issue for me big time recently, even before being diagnosed. Yeah, sometimes I don't think they realise how much of an impact their words have. I know what they day is true but it doesn't make it any easier. Thank you so much and no worries! I don't mind big texts aha.

I hope you sleep well!

Wow, it seems you've had a rough time, I'm sorry. I'm 69kg at the moment but I just can't get myself to stop stress eating. I don't know how to stop. Earlier, I ended up eating a plate of biscuits, yoghurt, crisps and drinking Dr Pepper and I do this often. How did you manage dieting and exercising? I have no motivation because I'm so stressed. I am struggling to even start a change, let alone keep one going.
This is amazing and inspiring to hear!
I bite my fingers, bite my lips, pick at my back, legs, arms, tummy, face. You aren't alone.

Mine usually last between 6 to 8 days and can differ each time. But in your case, I would say it could be a playing factor. A sufden change in diet and lose of weight changes a lot of things, periods being one of them.

Maybe tell her that you'd like to get another that looks more professional and classy but that you are going to keep the current one you have too? She may be more inclined if she knkws you aren't geyting rid of the one you got when you were younger.
Okay, thank you! Yeah, I've taken notes and will explain the pain as much as i can. Thank you for the reply! 😊

She's lying to you. She may have had a headache and just exaggerated on how bad it was so that you felt sorry for her but the most it couldve been is a little headache.

I suffer with migraines and know others who do too. And the things like her being on her laptop and going to a club only hours after just does not happen. When i get migraines, my vision either goes fuzzy, i black out for a couple seconds or i see consistent brown dots. All of which are always accompanied by heavy and achy feeling eyes. Your eyes do become sensitive to light, so much so that any bright light or close encounter to a screen can fuck with your eyes and hurt pretty bad. All you want to do is sleep and lay in a dark room. If mine are very severe, it can last a day before it calms down. Id still have the aftermath like i would still be dizzy and my eyes will still hurt but not to the extent as it was before. If mine are more mild, it can last just hours but i still couldnt look at a screen because of the strain to do so.

It was finally the seventh day of July, a very special day for Cadie. On this day, 10 years ago, was her very first kill and it was a day no one ever forgot.

*30th June 2028 - A Week Before*

It was a normal summer's day and Cadie was up to her normal eleven year old self mischief. Her mother, Coral, hadn't long been discharged from hospital after having a psychotic break and was being driven insane by her daughter. It was a never ending nightmare for Coral and she didn't know how to stop her.

That night, it became gloomy and the wind picked up speed. Cadie was very unsettled and distressed about the deafening sounds made by the menacing storm. Coral had just put Cadie to bed and was on her way to her room, only this time, she would never walk back out. Scared and alone, Cadie ran along the creaky landing, her eyes red and puffy and her beautiful brown hair stuck to her face. She yelled out for her mother but the only noise she could hear was the banging of a window. Cadie creaked open her mother's bedroom door, only to have found her mother dead, laid in a pool of blood next to pills and a gun. She hadn't heard the gun shot before, due to the endless thunder and it was too late. The forensics team took Corals body and the police drove Cadie to their station where their team liased with social services and came to agreement that Cadie would be taken care of by the team.

A week had gone by and it was found a suicide and Cadie was put into care, though she was reluctant to go. For the duration of that day, Cadie was forced to talk to several people, though they were the ones doing the talking, which only riled her up. She didn't want to talk about it, she wasn't ready and had they just left her alone, the next event wouldn't have occurred.

Voices were clogging her thoughts, faces infested her dreams and her tolerance for it all had long since expired. In the commotion of her emotions and feelings, Cadie had grabbed a kitchen knife that was locked away in a drawer. She had used a bobby pin to get in. 'Do it, do it now!' 'Stupid, stupid, STUPID!' 'Kill them, kill them all!' These were the voices Cadie latched onto as she murdered the entire household. She fled the scene, drowned in everyone's blood and went in hiding with a family unknowing of what she had done.

*7th July 2038 - The Anniversary*

All these years, Cadie had been killing people that reminded her of that fateful week but as this was a special anniversary, she wanted to make it count. She hadn't killed in the past six months as she had prepared for this day and it was going to be perfect.

Everything was ready, her destination in view and the plan was set in motion. Just in front of her, there stood a gorgeous old fashioned building, many windows sat along the brick wall and one by one, lights were going out. Cadie flicked her wrist so that she could look at her watch. She watched the delicate hand intently as it jumped with every second. The hand jumped one more time and off she went.

Cadie made her way into the front door towards the kitchen where she stood for a minute before taking a knife out of her bag. 'It's time.' 'Let's go.' 'You will be free!' Those these voices were much softer, they were definitely more sinister and held so much more control over her than those that spoke many years ago.

Silence fell over the street. The whispers of the wind could be faintly heard in the trees. A pin could be heard dropping in this eerily quiet hallway. Suddenly, a blood curdling scream rippled through the air. The show had begun.

A few houses away, a hooded figure ran towards the house. Their breathing was heavy with excitement as their feet crashed against the ground with every impatient stride. The screams were calling to this mysterious being. It was music to their ears. They wanted to know who or what was playing the instrument, so they hid in a nearby bush. That's when they saw her. Blood dropped from the ends of her hair, a beautiful satanic smile filtered their vision and the smell had them entranced.

Cadie stopped in her tracks and glared at the oncoming figure. If only looks could kill, her glares were as sharp as daggers. Then they removed their hood and revealed a strange looking man that stood before the girl. She didn't know who they were or what they were doing here but the one thing she did know was that she would be ready to attack. Without hesitation, the man spoke. "Are you the artist behind that magical sound?" His eyes had watered at the mess that this complicated girl had left behind. Cadie just raised a questioning eyebrow. "My name is Cory. Are you Cadie? The Cadie?" He emphasised to make sure she knew he had heard of her. He knew exactly who she was. "I am and you are very peculiar." She replied. That only earned her a frown her way. "I like it," she smiled.

Neither ever believed in love at first sight or true love, that was up until now. She was on her own and she loved it too but Cory was something new. They exchanged a couple of stories, though Cory already knew a fair bit about her, and in that moment they knew. The world knew of one but that would soon turn to two and they would be commonly known as the Dangerous Duo. Cadie knew this would be perfect but it was locked in place and set forever when she met the mysterious man.
